summary.en: The Safe first approves VaultBundlesV1 for exactly the amount you type, then calls `vaultBundlesV1Deposit` on it: VaultBundlesV1 pulls the tokens from the Safe and deposits them into the vault you pick, and the vault mints the shares straight to the Safe. You do not type the minimum shares: the program computes them from the vault's own preview when you build the card, less a small slippage; a higher price per share makes the transaction fail. The old route through Bundler3 is refused: verify returns MISMATCH.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 先授權 VaultBundlesV1 剛好你填的金額，再呼叫它的 `vaultBundlesV1Deposit`：VaultBundlesV1 從 Safe 拉走這筆代幣，存進你選的 vault，vault 把份額直接鑄給 Safe。最少份額不用你填：建卡片時，程式依 vault 自己的預覽算出，再扣一點滑價；每股價格更高時，交易會失敗。走 Bundler3 的舊路線不接受，verify 判 MISMATCH。

intro.en: A Morpho vault spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets to lend them out. Vaults are managed by curators, and Morpho's factory contracts create them.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho 的 vault 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue market 放貸。vault 由策展人管理，Morpho 的工廠合約負責建立它們。

text.en: VaultBundlesV1 has one audit, which AI read: Blackthorn, 14 to 21 July 2026, 0 high, 0 medium, 7 low or info. The two about this contract are marked resolved: one on deposit-gated vaults, one saying anyone could take tokens left in the contract, which it does not hold between transactions (resolved only by documenting it). AI compared the audit's final commit with the source on GitHub main: in VaultBundlesV1.sol and TokenLib.sol only comments, the licence and the compiler line differ. Vault V2's and MetaMorpho's own audits are in their repositories; AI did not read those.
text.zh-TW: VaultBundlesV1 有一份稽核，AI 讀過：Blackthorn，2026-07-14 到 07-21，高 0、中 0、低或資訊 7。與這個合約有關的兩項都標為已解決：一項關於限制存款人的 vault，一項說留在合約裡的代幣誰都能拿走，而合約在交易之間不留代幣（只用文件說明解決，沒改程式邏輯）。AI 把稽核的最終 commit 和 GitHub main 的原始碼比對，VaultBundlesV1.sol 和 TokenLib.sol 只差註解、授權條款和編譯器版本行。Vault V2 和 MetaMorpho 各自的稽核在它們的 repo，AI 沒有讀。

text.en: The Morpho app now asks for an unlimited approval by default, and this template accepts only an approval equal to the deposit. Example: you deposit 10,000 USDC; the app builds an approval of 2^256-1 (unlimited), the card wants exactly 10,000 USDC, so an unedited app transaction gets MISMATCH. The newest app transactions AI read (2026-11-20 and 11-21) were all unlimited; some older ones were exact, and how they came to be is unknown.
text.zh-TW: Morpho app 現在預設要求無限授權，這個模板只接受授權額等於存款額。例：存 10,000 USDC，app 組的授權是 2^256−1（無限），卡片要的是剛好 10,000 USDC，沒改就判 MISMATCH。AI 看到最新的 app 交易（2026-11-20、11-21）都是無限；較早有幾筆剛好等額，怎麼來的不知道。

recommendation.en: Before proposing, while nobody has signed, set the approval to the deposit amount (here 10,000) in Safe{Wallet} and press Save. AI read the web wallet's source: the review screen has this editor, also for an approval in a batch; AI did not try it live. If it does not appear, do not sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: 送出提案前、還沒人簽名時，在 Safe{Wallet} 把授權額改成存款額（這裡是 10,000）再按 Save。AI 讀過網頁版原始碼：確認畫面有這個編輯欄，批次裡的授權也能改；沒有實際操作過。看不到編輯欄就不要簽。

text.en: If the Safe already gave VaultBundlesV1 a large enough allowance, the app sends a deposit with no approval: MISMATCH. Others cannot spend that leftover: the contract pulls only from its own caller (AI read the source). But any later VaultBundlesV1 deposit the Safe signs can use it with no new approval, even into a fake vault or with a referral fee to someone else.
text.zh-TW: Safe 若已給 VaultBundlesV1 夠大的授權，app 只組存款、不再授權，判 MISMATCH。剩下的授權別人用不了：合約只從呼叫者自己拉代幣（AI 讀原始碼）。但 Safe 之後簽的任何一筆 VaultBundlesV1 存款都能直接動用，不用再授權，包括存進假 vault，或付推薦費給別人。

recommendation.en: First set the allowance back to 0 in a separate transaction, which this template does not cover; the app then builds approval and deposit again. Until then, check the vault, amount and referral fee of every VaultBundlesV1 transaction.
recommendation.zh-TW: 先用另一筆交易把授權改回 0（這個模板不管那筆），app 才會重新組出授權加存款。改回之前，每筆 VaultBundlesV1 交易都要看清楚 vault、金額和推薦費。

role.en: The token deposited into a USDC vault
role.zh-TW: 存進 USDC vault 的代幣

role.en: Morpho's vault bundle contract. It receives the allowance, pulls the tokens from the Safe, deposits them into the vault and has the vault mint the shares to the Safe, its caller
role.zh-TW: Morpho 的 vault bundle 合約：收下授權、從 Safe 拉代幣、存進 vault，並讓 vault 把份額直接發給呼叫它的 Safe

1.approve.spender.en: The contract allowed to pull tokens from the Safe: VaultBundlesV1, which pulls this amount with `transferFrom` in call 2.
1.approve.spender.zh-TW: 被授權從 Safe 拉代幣的合約：VaultBundlesV1，呼叫 2 裡它用 `transferFrom` 拉走這筆錢。

1.approve.value.en: The allowance, exactly the deposit amount, so call 2 uses all of it and none is left. The app asks for unlimited by default; that is MISMATCH.
1.approve.value.zh-TW: 授權額，剛好等於存款金額，呼叫 2 會全部用完、不留剩餘。app 預設要求無限，那會判 MISMATCH。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.vault.en: The vault that receives the deposit.

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assets.en: The amount pulled from the Safe. A referral fee would come out of it; the fee is bound to 0, so all of it is deposited.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assets.zh-TW: 從 Safe 拉走的金額。推薦費會從裡面扣；推薦費綁定為 0，所以全部存入。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.maxSharePriceE27.en: The highest price per share (assets ÷ shares, times 1e27). If the actual price is higher, the whole transaction fails. The program requires it to be no higher than "amount ÷ minimum shares", so you get at least the minimum shares by the count the vault itself reports.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.maxSharePriceE27.zh-TW: 每股最高價格（資產 ÷ 份額，乘以 1e27）。實際價格更高，整筆失敗。程式要求它不高於「金額 ÷ 最少份額」，所以依 vault 自己回報的份額數，你至少拿到最少份額。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.en: A signature that would replace the approval. A Safe uses the approval in call 1 instead, so this is empty.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.zh-TW: 用簽名代替授權的資料。Safe 用呼叫 1 的授權，所以這裡是空的。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.kind.en: 0 means no permit: the tokens are pulled with the approval. 1 is ERC-2612 and 2 is Permit2, both refused.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.kind.zh-TW: 0 表示不用 permit，靠授權拉代幣。1 是 ERC-2612、2 是 Permit2，都不接受。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.data.en: The permit's data. With kind 0 the contract does not read it. It was empty in all 31 past transactions that fit the template.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.assetPermit.data.zh-TW: permit 的資料。kind 是 0 時合約不讀它。過去符合模板的 31 筆都是空的。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeePct.en: The share of the deposit paid to a referrer. Bound to 0: nothing is taken.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeePct.zh-TW: 從存款抽給推薦人的比例。綁定為 0，不抽。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeeRecip.en: Who would receive the referral fee. Bound to the zero address.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.referralFeeRecip.zh-TW: 收推薦費的人。綁定為零地址。

2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.deadline.en: After this time the transaction fails. The app sets two hours from when it builds it, so a Safe that executes later must rebuild it. Of the 31 past transactions that fit, one ran 496,672 seconds (about 5.7 days) before its deadline, so the limit is 7 days; half ran less than 7,051 seconds before.
2.vaultBundlesV1Deposit.deadline.zh-TW: 過了這個時間交易就失敗。app 設在組交易後兩小時，Safe 較晚執行就要重新組。過去符合的 31 筆裡，最久的一筆在期限前 496,672 秒（約 5.7 天）執行，所以上限是 7 天；一半在期限前 7,051 秒以內執行。
